claim_text: A great shaking to Canada and British Columbia and their economy, with people trying to leave Canada for America in droves because it was like a great depression, and a major war kicking off with Putin if the nations keep trying to strong-arm him.
quote: trying to figure out how they could leave Canada
falsify_match: Net emigration from Canada to the United States at an unusual scale during a Canadian downturn.
falsify_miss: Migration flows stay ordinary. Canadian emigration to the US has been rising modestly since 2019, so a rise alone would not distinguish this.

claim_text: Strategic plans to disarm and split Israel, after which nations that do not stand with Israel get great earthquakes, weather events and economic events of biblical proportion, with Canada, India and parts of Europe named.
quote: the ones that do not stand with Israel, I saw great earthquakes
falsify_match: Disasters concentrated in the countries that back Palestinian statehood, beyond what their exposure would predict.
falsify_miss: Disasters fall where they normally do. Earthquakes, storms and downturns occur in all three named regions every year, so the rule confirms itself by construction.

claim_text: Gross darkness on the land beyond anything comprehensible, quoted from Isaiah 60, with Australia urged to stand with Israel against a two-state solution.
quote: there'll be gross darkness upon the land beyond anything you can comprehend
falsify_match: Australia suffering an identifiable reversal after recognising Palestinian statehood.
falsify_miss: Australia recognised Palestinian statehood on 21 September 2025 with no such reversal in the following year.

claim_text: Closing exhortation that America is not being made great but kept afloat, that the tribulation is at the doorstep, and that the response is not fear but preparation.
quote: We're having a window of making America float
falsify_match: Not applicable; framing rather than prediction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: He states the rule that a shaking in the natural is what brings the shaking in the spiritual and the major revival, applied to the ring of fire over Asia after another large Russian earthquake.
quote: A shaking in the natural, a shaking in the spiritual
falsify_match: Religious movements following large earthquakes in the same regions.
falsify_miss: No such correlation. Stated as a rule, so it can be checked against several events rather than one, but seismic activity on the ring of fire is continuous.

claim_text: A shaking in Russia and a major move of God in Russia, Japan, China and South Korea, with eastern Russia counted as part of Asia.
quote: a major move of God in Japan, a major move of God in China
falsify_match: Documented religious growth in all four named countries.
falsify_miss: No measurable change. South Korean Protestantism has been in slow decline, which is the leg most likely to fail.

claim_text: The iron curtain comes down in North Korea for a short window in which many are born again, and then it does not stay down for very long.
quote: the iron curtain will not stay down for very long
falsify_match: A period of religious opening in North Korea followed by re-closure.
falsify_miss: No opening occurs. The short window framing means even a brief and unverifiable opening could be claimed.

claim_text: A major move of God inside the Catholic Church and its 1.4 billion people, with the pope seen trying to bring in a younger generation as the older one dies, and a South Korean flag seen alongside.
quote: a major move of God in the Catholic Church
falsify_match: A measurable turn among Catholic youth traceable to a papal initiative.
falsify_miss: Catholic practice keeps declining in the West. He notes his wife told him the pope had already called for youth revival, so the news came first.

claim_text: He says he was present in the spirit at a meeting he is forbidden to describe, in which North Korea and Cuba were in the shadows with a plan the Americans did not know about, and that a third world war is rice paper thin away.
quote: I can't say what was in the meeting
falsify_match: A disclosed North Korean and Cuban plan against America.
falsify_miss: No such plan surfaces. He withholds the content himself, which is the sixth withholding recorded in this corpus and removes anything to check.

claim_text: He repeats that the escalation could go beyond control and that Australia would be involved, with a lot of people having the potential to die.
quote: Australia be involved
falsify_match: Australian combat involvement in a European or Pacific war.
falsify_miss: Australia stays out. This repeats the previous passage with the Australian detail added.

claim_text: Decisions coming along the whole British Columbia coastline and in Canada, with Carney said to have already decided the wrong way on the two-state question, and the same line extending into England.
quote: He's already decided to go the wrong way
falsify_match: Canada and the United Kingdom recognising Palestinian statehood, followed by identifiable consequences in both.
falsify_miss: Both recognised in September 2025; the consequences are the untested half. Canada's intention had been signalled publicly before this was recorded.

claim_text: Every place that decides that way sees a great shaking, and India is seen again with the temples crumbling from within and monkeys on them.
quote: The the the temples in India. I see them completely crumbling within
falsify_match: Indian temples destroyed by earthquakes.
falsify_miss: No such destruction. The monkeys are a recurring identifying detail across tellings, which makes the vision stable.

claim_text: Earthquakes bigger than any on record, well beyond 5.0 tremors, in multiple places at once, because the earth's crust is shifting from an outside source.
quote: earthquakes bigger than we've ever seen before
falsify_match: An earthquake exceeding the 1960 Chile magnitude 9.5, or several magnitude 9 events in a short span.
falsify_miss: No earthquake exceeds the instrumental record. This is one of the few claims here with a hard historical benchmark to beat.

claim_text: Everything known changes in a 24 hour period, with an expiration date on what has been known and a point of no return already reached.
quote: There's an expiration date to what we've known
falsify_match: A single day after which conditions are recognisably different.
falsify_miss: No such day. No date is given here at all, so this telling cannot expire.

claim_text: A cap that has been on American revival since the tent meetings of Jack Coe, Oral Roberts and Kathryn Kuhlman is removed, with deep wells rather than shallow ones, and people are warned not to become desensitised to raisings from the dead.
quote: I saw a cap. And the Lord said, I'm removing the cap
falsify_match: Verified resurrections or healings at a rate that would be reported outside the movement.
falsify_miss: No such reports. He refers to five raisings a couple of weeks earlier as if already known, which is a claim about the past with no source given.

claim_text: Persecution of Christians in Iran and the Middle East and people being slain in Africa, which he says is not being reported on the news.
quote: I see people being slain
falsify_match: Not applicable as a prediction; it describes a present situation that is in fact already documented by monitoring organisations.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. The claim that it is unreported is the part that is wrong rather than unverifiable.

claim_text: He says angel armies stood on the western seashore of California in answer to the live stream prayer and were sent on to Hawaii, and that the tsunami from the large earthquake caused no major damage anywhere as a result.
quote: I saw angel armies coming and standing on the the western seashore
falsify_match: Not checkable as stated: the absence of damage is offered as the proof.
falsify_miss: The 29 July 2025 Kamchatka earthquake produced tsunami waves that were forecast as small on the American coast before the prayer, so the low damage was the expected outcome and not evidence of intervention.

claim_text: Mount Fuji explodes with a force he compares to a major atomic blast, the snow cap completely levelled, suddenly and with civilians going about an ordinary day, and Japan's economy crumbles because of it.
quote: I saw Mount Fuji explode
falsify_match: An eruption of Mount Fuji large enough to remove the summit snowfield and damage the Japanese economy.
falsify_miss: Fuji stays quiet. Its last eruption was 1707 and it is monitored continuously; a named volcano is the strongest form this claim could take.

claim_text: Japan seen divided into two with major tsunami waves coming inland, a mile wide volcano about to go off in the water off Oregon, and the entire coastline from British Columbia to Alaska on fire from natural gas coming up out of the ground.
quote: everything was on fire from British Columbia all the way up to Alaska
falsify_match: A submarine eruption off Oregon, or a coastal fire event running the length of the BC and Alaska shoreline.
falsify_miss: Neither occurs. He says himself he does not understand the fire and does not want to add to what he saw, which leaves the mechanism unstated.

claim_text: A major revival coming out of Africa which he could hear as singing, alongside Australia not wanting to be drawn into the war and North Korea and Cuba again in the shadows.
quote: I could hear the revival coming to Africa
falsify_match: An identifiable African revival movement of unusual scale.
falsify_miss: No such movement beyond the existing rate of African church growth, which has been the fastest in the world for decades.

claim_text: Cuba named again as the place to watch, with mules in the night and darkness, and North Korea seen again, given as a standing warning he says has been repeated many times.
quote: Mules in the night, darkness
falsify_match: A night movement of materiel or personnel into Cuba.
falsify_miss: Nothing of the kind is reported. Mules in the night is an image without a stated referent, so almost any Cuban story could be read onto it.

claim_text: A great shaking coming to New York, California, Seattle and Portland, with the rule that the bluer the state the greater the harvest, and one last visitation on the Minnesota church that will come through the sons and daughters rather than the founders.
quote: the greater the blue the state is, the greater the har
falsify_match: Religious growth concentrated in those four places and a documented revival at the named church.
falsify_miss: No such concentration. He attaches the claim to David Wilkerson's New York prophecy, which was given in 1973 and has been carried forward ever since.

claim_text: Markets will be shaken, repeated three times, with Japan and the Japanese economy named.
quote: Markets will be shaken. Make a great shaking Japan
falsify_match: A Japanese market shock of unusual size.
falsify_miss: The Nikkei trades within ordinary volatility. Markets are shaken by some definition every year, so scale is what matters.

claim_text: In New York he sees smoke, sirens, ambulances and fire trucks at street level, an event that has happened, a major uprising and civil unrest.
quote: Civil unrest is coming. Civil unrest
falsify_match: Sustained civil disorder in New York with an emergency response of that kind.
falsify_miss: No such disorder. New York has ordinary emergency call volume of this description every day, so the vision as described matches a normal street scene.

claim_text: A hair thin line concerning Zelensky and Poland, described as a split decision that only needs a reason to push the button, with escalation of the Ukraine war in store.
quote: I see a thin line concerning Zalinski. Poland
falsify_match: A Polish entry into the war or a NATO article 5 trigger from Polish territory.
falsify_miss: Poland stays out. Russian drones did cross into Poland on 10 September 2025 without triggering entry, which is the near miss this points at.

claim_text: He repeats that the line is hair thin and that the situation only needs a reason, with Poland and Zelensky named again.
quote: That's how close to this thing to really kicking off
falsify_match: Escalation traceable to a Polish incident.
falsify_miss: No escalation. This repeats the preceding passage.

claim_text: Sheep nations and goat nations divided with great judgments on the wrong side, naming Canada, England, the EU and India, and recalling a grey bearded leader voting against Israel on war crimes.
quote: Don't be on the wrong side of this Canada
falsify_match: Identifiable judgments falling on the named states after they vote against Israel.
falsify_miss: Nothing distinguishes their fortunes from other countries. The list covers most of the developed world outside America, so some misfortune in it is certain.

claim_text: The grey bearded man is identified by his son as Modi, voting against Israel on war crimes, and a great shaking comes to India with the temples falling to dust and monkeys on them.
quote: That's the man, Marty. Modi a great shaking is coming to India
falsify_match: India voting against Israel in a war crimes context, followed by a major Indian earthquake destroying temples.
falsify_miss: India abstained rather than voting against Israel on the major 2025 UN resolutions, and no such earthquake followed. The identification is made by his son from memory, not in the vision.

claim_text: Zelensky is a marionette on strings doing what the weasel tells him, with North Korea behind the shadows, given while praying in tongues for de-escalation.
quote: He's a marionette. He's on his strings
falsify_match: Evidence that Ukrainian war decisions were directed by a European figure.
falsify_miss: No such evidence. The weasel is unnamed here, so the accusation has no subject to check.

claim_text: Iceland seen, then Cuba three times with an instruction to watch it, in the middle of the night, and Cuba being promised things and described as prime.
quote: Watch Cuba. They're being promised things
time_phrase: in the middle of the night
falsify_match: A night-time deployment or agreement involving Cuba.
falsify_miss: Nothing occurs. Iceland is named once here and never explained, which is worth keeping in case it recurs.

claim_text: An altar call and the sinner's prayer offered to viewers, with the baptism of the Holy Ghost held out.
quote: I want you to make a stand for Jesus
falsify_match: Not applicable; an invitation rather than a claim.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Sign-off in which the Russian earthquake that had just happened is mentioned by the crew as news.
quote: they're talking about the earthquake hit Russia
falsify_match: Not applicable; a news mention at the close.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it dates the Kamchatka earthquake as already known at this recording.

claim_text: He reports viewers telling him Harvard has said an alien ship is coming by November, and takes it as confirmation of the word he gave, adding that a great deception is coming and that his channel will have the news before it happens.
quote: Harvard said something's going to come by November
falsify_match: An object arriving in November 2025 that is presented publicly as a craft.
falsify_miss: 3I/ATLAS was an interstellar comet observed from July 2025; the Harvard claim was one researcher's speculation, widely rejected, and no craft arrived. He treats a news report as confirmation of his own word.

claim_text: Revival hot spots seen in Branson, Tulsa and Fort Worth, then across Kentucky and Tennessee, then Oregon, Washington, California and Nevada, with the rule stated that the bluer and more liberal the state, the greater the harvest.
quote: The bluer the state, son, the more liberal it is, the greater the harvest
falsify_match: Religious affiliation and attendance rising fastest in the most Democratic states.
falsify_miss: Growth stays flat or concentrated in the South. This is the earliest telling of the rule on file and it names the states, which makes it checkable against survey data.

claim_text: The coming revival breaks out unpredictably like popcorn in a hot pan, in many places at once, and cannot be controlled or organised the way Brownsville and other revivals were.
quote: They're going to be popped all over the place
falsify_match: Simultaneous unconnected revival outbreaks in many places.
falsify_miss: No outbreak occurs. The unpredictability is built into the claim, which removes any place where its absence could be checked.

claim_text: A huge telescope in the Arizona west with men in lab coats writing that the odds are in their favour, communicating with China, who take it seriously and say it will hit, while the Americans do not.
quote: the odds are in our favor
falsify_match: A disagreement between Chinese and American astronomers over an impact probability, made public.
falsify_miss: No such disagreement. Impact probabilities are published openly by the international minor planet centre, so a hidden American assessment would be difficult to sustain.

claim_text: A massive planet-sized rock heading for Earth with a smaller one beside it and many planet killers behind, withheld from the public because it would cause panic, with the official line being that it will miss.
quote: We will not tell them for it is will cause panic
falsify_match: An impact by a large object, or the disclosure of a suppressed impact assessment.
falsify_miss: No impact and no suppression uncovered. A planet-sized object approaching Earth would be visible to amateur astronomers years out, which makes concealment at that scale impossible.

claim_text: Multiple volcanoes erupting at the same time and earthquakes greater than 9.0 in several places at once, with the rock affecting the tides, the sun's light changed, animals migrating and breeding wrongly and agriculture thrown off.
quote: it will be multiple all at the same time
falsify_match: Two or more magnitude 9 earthquakes and several major eruptions within a short window.
falsify_miss: No such cluster. Only five magnitude 9 earthquakes have been instrumentally recorded in the past century, so simultaneity would be unmistakable.

claim_text: Water events in Venice never seen before with rising tides and flooding, a volcano about to go off in Europe near Rome, and pagan temples across India and Asia destroyed by earthquakes with a great revival following.
quote: Water events are about to take place in Italy
falsify_match: Venice flooding beyond its recorded maxima, or a Roman-area eruption.
falsify_miss: Acqua alta stays within the range the MOSE barriers were built for. Venice floods most winters, so only a record event would count.

claim_text: Three or four massive golden ship anchor chains extending from the state of Missouri straight up into the sky, pulled tight with no slack, glowing transparent gold and sparkling.
quote: golden chains that are being extended straight up into the heavens
falsify_match: Not checkable in the natural; he says himself he does not know what it is.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Recorded because the location is specific and recurs with the Branson and New Madrid material.

claim_text: The chains come out of Missouri and parts of Oklahoma, running from Tulsa over to Branson and up by Kansas City, marking an area he says is anchored.
quote: it's coming out of Missouri and parts of Oklahoma
falsify_match: Revival concentrated in that specific triangle.
falsify_miss: Nothing distinguishes it. The triangle is where he lives and where the churches he names are, which is worth noting.

claim_text: The war news, the tariff threats and the Epstein list are a sleight of hand distracting from what is being built on the other hand, which he says is a one world government and a digital platform for the beast system, and he dates the warning to a 17 June prayer.
quote: The slight of hand is going on with this hand
falsify_match: A major structural change passed while attention was on Ukraine and Epstein.
falsify_miss: Nothing of the kind passes. The claim names no specific measure, so any later legislation could be fitted to it.

claim_text: BRICS are biding their time through the presidency, holding their cards and laughing behind closed doors at the tariff threats, waiting out the three and a half years.
quote: they're just biting they're buying biting their time
falsify_match: BRICS acting decisively against the dollar after January 2029.
falsify_miss: BRICS members split over the dollar within the period. The three and a half years is read off the presidential term, not given as a revealed date.

claim_text: Cuba to be watched over biological things and Russian nuclear submarines, with Russia extending an olive branch of relief from sanctions to Cuba, Venezuela and North Korea in exchange for alliance.
quote: Watch Cuba with biological things with with the Russian nuclear subs
falsify_match: Russian submarines or a biological facility in Cuba.
falsify_miss: Neither appears. Russian naval visits to Havana had already occurred in June 2024 and were widely reported.

claim_text: A new BRICS alliance rises against the dollar, the euro and the SWIFT system with a new digital platform, and America loses the dollar standard in the days ahead, which he says makes way for the beast system.
quote: We will lose in the days ahead the dollar standard
falsify_match: The dollar losing majority reserve status.
falsify_miss: The dollar holds roughly sixty percent of allocated reserves and no rival is close. The days ahead carries no date, so this cannot expire.
